question: Does current Asian realised variance provide incremental information about London realised variance?
target: London M5 midpoint realised variance, unannualised sum of squared log returns

data_quality.source_flat_policy: Retain genuine received flat bars; no inserted bars, interpolation, forward fill or flat-only deletion. Quote volume is recorded, not central traded volume.

estimation: OLS of log variance with intercept; exponentiate using training-only mean(exp(residual)) smearing. Clip variance forecasts below 1e-12 only. No target clipping.
period_note: Use only actually available provider history; 1999 is a search-window bound, not a claim that M1 exists then.
training: First 400 eligible labelled observations on new provider history, targets completed before origin; then freeze coefficients/smearing once.
secondary_note: Already viewed market periods on a new source; do not pool into primary fresh-period N or claim virgin-outcome confirmation.

acceptance.source: Direct provider HTTPS delivery or authenticated documented export on a feed independent of OANDA; no mirrors.
acceptance.feasibility: Required unique scored dates must be available before forecast evaluation; do not multiply N by broker count.
acceptance.label_coverage: At least 95% of issued confirmation forecasts have qualifying London outcomes; missingness diagnostics required.
acceptance.primary_qlike: Positive mean HAR-minus-HAR+Asia QLIKE loss and lower two-sided 95% paired block CI above zero for all 5/10/20 blocks.
acceptance.coefficient: Current Asia coefficient positive in frozen initial training fit.
acceptance.year_consistency: Positive mean primary QLIKE difference in each full scored calendar year; partial startup year is descriptive.
acceptance.secondary_losses: No more than 5% MSE or MAE deterioration versus HAR.
acceptance.magnitude: Report relative effect and CI against the 5% design target; passing positivity does not prove benefit >=5%.
acceptance.nested_inference: Primary evaluates fixed trained forecast pairs conditional on training; conventional DM is descriptive. Clark-West on nested linear log-MSPE is secondary, never mechanically applied to QLIKE.
acceptance.missing_or_insufficient: Acceptance-inconclusive; no gate reduction, alternate model, date selection or trading test.

data_source_plan.priority_1: Direct Dukascopy provider M1 bid/ask or ticks, provider access verified with pre-2024 probes.
data_source_plan.priority_2: Authenticated JForex historical export or provider-documented requester-pays S3 with explicit credentials/budget.
data_source_plan.priority_3: A second independently originating broker export with documented symbol, dates and paired quotes; requires source-specific amendment before its outcome evaluation.
data_source_plan.oanda_role: Coverage diagnosis and pilot only; additional OANDA history is not an independent-provider confirmation.
data_source_plan.capacity_stop: If pre-2024 fresh unique dates cannot supply the frozen N, do not bulk acquire for a nominally powered study.

trading_candidate.status: Preregistered but disabled until forecast and independent-feed gates pass
trading_candidate.comparison: strictly greater than linear-interpolated 80th percentile of previous 60 RV values, excluding current session
trading_candidate.entry: First bid boundary break; upper boundary buys at contemporaneous ask; lower boundary sells at bid; observed quote sequence required
trading_candidate.stop: Long exits when bid <= Asian bid low; short exits when ask >= Asian bid high
trading_candidate.news_filter: None; fixed exit. No historical news rule claimed.
trading_candidate.execution_requirement: Provider tick bid/ask replay with broker sizing; M1 may give a conservative diagnostic only, never a validated execution claim
trading_candidate.trading_gate: Positive net development and validation expectancy; validation 95% five-trade-block bootstrap lower bound >0 at base and doubled costs; at least 100 development and 50 validation trades; unresolved execution paths must block acceptance

trading_condition: Run the unchanged candidate exactly once only after confirmation passes, using independent ordered bid/ask ticks and verified contract sizing. Failure ends this translation.
holdout_policy: 2024-01-01 onward remains locked, including 2024-2026. No query, forecast evaluation, news/trade study or runner for this interval.
ea_or_cpp_work: Deferred; neither is part of this design pack.
monetisation_extensions: Any volatility-instrument or execution/risk application is a separately registered later study.
